microsoft.oneClickDisabled: One-click managed consent is not enabled on this deployment. Use the instant scan or CSV import below.
microsoft.forwardHint: Not a Global Administrator? Forward this page to one — they complete the Microsoft dialog and you become the workspace owner.
microsoft.advancedSummary: Advanced — bring your own app registration
microsoft.instantScanBody: One-time scan with the same read-only scopes, running with your permissions while you are signed in. No standing access, no stored tokens. Works for Application and Cloud Application Administrators, who cannot grant the consent above.
microsoft.csvHint: No admin with consent rights at hand? Start with the CSV import: two admin-center exports, no consent at all.
microsoft.demoBody: Connected with demo data. On a real workspace, a Global Administrator grants read-only access in one click, or you bring your own Entra app registration.
microsoft.managedFlowNote: The managed flow opens Microsoft's consent screen. No password or delegated user token is stored.
microsoft.credentialExpired: The stored credential expired on {date}. Re-enter it below to resume the nightly sync.
microsoft.credentialExpiring: The stored credential expires on {date}. Renew it in Entra and re-enter it below before then to avoid a sync gap.
microsoft.switchToByo: Switch to your own app registration (Advanced)
microsoft.notConnectedViewer: Not connected. A workspace admin can connect Microsoft 365 here.
microsoft.readOnlyNote: Read-only application permissions only. Nothing is ever written to your tenant, and mailbox or file contents are never readable. Full details for your security team: <link>security overview</link>.

adobe.demoBody: Connected with demo data: {count} Adobe seats correlated against the directory.
adobe.setupBody: A System Admin creates an OAuth server-to-server project with the User Management API, then enters the organization ID, client ID, and client secret. The secret is encrypted at rest and used read-only.
adobe.microsoftDisconnectedNotice: Microsoft 365 is disconnected, so this connector can't cross-check seats against your directory or run new syncs. <link>Reconnect Microsoft</link> to resume.
adobe.needsMicrosoftFirst: Connectors cross-check seats against your Microsoft 365 directory, so <link>connect your tenant</link> first.
adobe.syncFailedNote: The last sync could not reach Adobe. Findings are based on the previous snapshot. If the credentials were changed or revoked, update them below or reconnect with fresh values.
adobe.setupBodyAdmin: Detect Adobe seats still assigned to people who are disabled or gone in Entra ID. Create an OAuth server-to-server project with the User Management API in the Adobe Developer Console (System Admin required), then paste the credentials. They are stored encrypted and used read-only.
adobe.notConnectedViewer: Not connected. A workspace admin can connect the Adobe Admin Console here.
adobe.detectsDisabled: Adobe seats whose owner is disabled in Entra ID: paid Creative Cloud for accounts that can no longer sign in.
adobe.detectsOrphaned: Orphaned Adobe seats with no matching directory account at all.
adobe.entitlementsNote: Entitlements only: no Adobe documents or content are read. Prices are editable in your license price book.

adobeForm.disconnectConfirm: This removes the connection and its synced Adobe seats. Press again to confirm.

microsoftForm.secretExpiryLabel: Secret expiry (optional, for the renewal reminder)
microsoftForm.disconnectConfirm: This removes the Microsoft connection and stops the nightly sync. Press again to confirm.

saasForm.disconnectConfirmUnpriced: This removes the connection, the imported {label} members and the spend history. Press again to confirm.
saasForm.disconnectConfirm: This removes the connection and its imported {label} seats. Press again to confirm.
